name: reporting-platform
description: Open source reporting and declarative report UIs.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @reporting/core build && pnpm --filter @reporting/react-ui build && pnpm --filter @reporting/mcp-server build && pnpm --filter @reporting/agent-kit build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @reporting/core test && pnpm --filter @reporting/mcp-server test && pnpm --filter @reporting/agent-kit test
scripts.ci: pnpm run build && pnpm run test
